Discover the fascinating history of Gold Spot, Campa Cola, Coca-Cola and Thums Up in India. From the 1971 India-Pakistan war and Cold War politics to the 1993 Coca-Cola comeback and Reliance’s Campa revival, explore how geopolitics, business rivalries and nostalgia shaped India's soft drink market.
Khabargaon is a modern-day digital platform that helps you travel through current affairs, explainers, ground reports, interviews and unique video shows. Stay tuned for more and more!
